definitions.explanation: The vacation period in spring between academic years, typically from late March to early April.

examples.japanese: {春休|はるやす}みはいつからですか。
{春休|はるやす}みに{友達|ともだち}と{遊園地|ゆうえんち}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the amusement park with friends during spring break.

examples.japanese: {春休|はるやす}みが{終|お}わると{新|あたら}しい{学年|がくねん}が{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: When spring break ends, the new school year begins.

notes:
{春休|はるやす}み is the school vacation period in spring, typically late March to early April.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese school year starts in April, so {春休|はるやす}み falls between academic years — after graduation in March and before the new term in April. It is typically about two weeks long, shorter than {夏休|なつやす}み.

RELATED VACATION WORDS:
- {夏休|なつやす}み: summer vacation (longest, ~40 days)
- {冬休|ふゆやす}み: winter break (~2 weeks, around New Year)
- {春休|はるやす}み: spring break (~2 weeks)
- {連休|れんきゅう}: consecutive holidays

USAGE:
Unlike summer and winter breaks, {春休|はるやす}み typically has no homework assigned, since students are transitioning between school years.
